title: What if the Sun Turned Blue?
script: What if our yellow Sun suddenly turned into a giant blue star? Blue stars burn much hotter than yellow ones, reaching surface temperatures over thirty thousand degrees. The intense ultraviolet radiation would fry Earth's atmosphere within days. Oceans would boil into steam, and plant life would quickly scorch to ash. Without deep underground bunkers, nothing could survive the blinding heat. Follow for more what if stories.

title: What If Humans Stopped Dying?
script: What if every human alive today simply stopped dying? At first, it sounds like a miracle. But within just decades, Earth's population would explode past thirty billion people. Cities would run out of fresh water and food almost immediately. Without room to build, society would collapse under its own weight. Eternal life might actually become our worst nightmare. Follow for more what if stories.

title: What if Earth Heated Up by Four Degrees?
script: A rise of just four degrees would turn our green planet into a living nightmare. Massive heatwaves would make entire tropical regions too dangerous for human survival. Ocean currents would collapse, disrupting weather worldwide. Fertile farmlands would dry into vast deserts, triggering global food shortages. Wildfires would rage nonstop, while superstorms batter flooded coastlines. Follow for more what if stories.

title: What if Earth stopped spinning?
script: In one second, Earth stops spinning. At the equator, the ground stops, but you and the air keep moving at over one thousand miles an hour. Winds would rip across the land. The oceans would surge over the coasts in giant waves. And after that, one single day would last a whole year, half in burning light, half in freezing dark. Earth keeps spinning for a reason. Follow for more what if stories.

title: What if the Sun disappeared?
script: What if the Sun vanished right now? For eight minutes, nothing would change. You would still see it, and Earth would keep orbiting, because light and gravity both take eight minutes to reach us. Then the sky goes dark, and Earth flies off in a straight line through space. Within a week, most places drop below freezing. Within a year, the ocean surface freezes over. Follow for more what if stories.

title: What if humans disappeared?
script: What if every human vanished tomorrow? Within days, the power grid fails and the lights go out. Pumps stop, and subway tunnels fill with water. Within a few years, plants crack the roads open. After a few decades, many buildings start to fall. Some power plants could even have serious accidents without anyone to run them. Nature would take back our cities, but our plastic would stay for ages. Follow for more what if stories.

title: What if you fell into a black hole?
script: What if you fell into a black hole? As you get closer, gravity pulls your feet harder than your head. You get stretched out like a noodle. Scientists really call this spaghettification. A friend watching from far away would see you slow down and fade, but never quite disappear. You, though, would feel every second. Follow for more what if stories.

title: What if everyone jumped at once?
script: What if every person on Earth jumped at the same time? Eight billion people, all in the air for one second. Would the planet shake? Not really. Earth is so heavy that it would move by far less than the width of an atom. All of humanity together is tiny next to our planet. Follow for more what if stories.

title: What if gravity doubled?
script: What if Earth's gravity suddenly doubled? You would weigh twice as much, and every step would feel like carrying a person on your back. Your heart would work much harder. Tall trees would struggle to stand, and tall animals would collapse under their own weight. Birds would barely get off the ground. Follow for more what if stories.

title: What if you dove into the Mariana Trench?
script: What if you dove to the bottom of the Mariana Trench? That is almost seven miles down. The pressure there is more than one thousand times stronger than at the surface. Any space filled with air in your body would be crushed. It is also freezing, and completely dark. Only a few strange animals can live there. Follow for more what if stories.

title: What if the Moon disappeared?
script: What if the Moon suddenly disappeared? First, the night would get much darker. Second, ocean tides would almost stop, and sea life would be confused. Third, Earth would wobble more on its axis, so seasons could become extreme over thousands of years. The Moon does more than shine. It keeps our planet stable. Follow for more what if stories.

title: What if you never slept?
script: What if you never slept again? After one day, your focus drops. After three days, you start seeing things that are not there. After eleven days, memory and mood break down badly. Sleep is when your brain cleans itself and saves memories. Skip it, and your body shuts you down. Follow for more what if stories.

title: What if the internet stopped for a day?
script: What if the internet stopped for one whole day? Banks could not move money. Flights would be delayed. Hospitals would lose records. Even your phone would feel useless. We built a world that runs on invisible connections. Follow for more what if stories.

title: What if you fell into the Sun?
script: What if you fell straight into the Sun? The trip would take about two months. By the time you got close, you would be moving at more than six hundred kilometers per second. But you would never get that far. The Sun's surface is about five thousand five hundred degrees Celsius, and the heat would destroy you long before. Follow for more what if stories.

title: What if all the ice melted?
script: What if all the ice on Earth melted? Sea levels would rise by about seventy meters, which is over two hundred feet. Coastal cities like New York, Shanghai and Mumbai would go underwater. Millions of square miles of land would vanish under the sea. Luckily, this would take thousands of years. Follow for more what if stories.

title: What if Earth had no air?
script: What if Earth lost its atmosphere? The sky would turn black, even in daytime. Sound could not travel, so the world would be silent. Nothing could breathe, and temperatures would swing from burning hot to freezing cold. Our thin layer of air is the only thing keeping us alive. Follow for more what if stories.

title: What if you went to space without a suit?
script: What if you floated into space with no spacesuit? You would not explode, and you would not freeze instantly. But the air would rush out of your lungs. You would stay conscious for only about ten to fifteen seconds. After that, you would pass out. Space is not hot or cold. It is empty, and that is the danger. Follow for more what if stories.

title: What if Earth stopped orbiting the Sun?
script: What if Earth suddenly stopped moving around the Sun? Our orbital speed is about thirty kilometers per second. Without it, nothing would hold us up against the Sun's gravity. Earth would fall straight toward the Sun. It would take about two months to get there. Our planet stays safe only because it keeps moving sideways. Follow for more what if stories.

title: What if Earth's core stopped moving?
script: What if Earth's core cooled down and stopped moving? The magnetic field it creates would fade away. Without it, the solar wind would slowly strip our atmosphere, like what happened on Mars. The air would thin, the water would vanish, and the surface would dry out. Deep inside Earth, a hot churning core protects all life. Follow for more what if stories.

title: What if you dug a tunnel through Earth?
script: What if you dug a tunnel straight through Earth and jumped in? In a perfect tunnel with no air, you would fall faster and faster. You would pass the center, then slow down. You would reach the other side in about forty two minutes, and stop right at the surface. Follow for more what if stories.

title: What if the Sun became a black hole?
script: What if the Sun turned into a black hole? Here is the surprising part. Earth would not get sucked in. A black hole with the same mass has the same gravity from far away, so Earth would keep orbiting. But the light would be gone. It would turn dark and freezing cold, and life would end. Follow for more what if stories.

title: What if the power went out everywhere?
script: What if the power grid failed across the whole world? Lights go out in seconds. Traffic lights stop, and trains stand still. Water pumps stop, and food in fridges begins to spoil. Hospitals switch to backup power, but fuel runs out fast. Modern life runs on electricity more than we think. Follow for more what if stories.

title: What if all the insects disappeared?
script: What if every insect on Earth disappeared? Many flowers and crops would stop being pollinated. Birds, fish and frogs that eat insects would starve. Dead plants and animals would pile up, because insects help break them down. Tiny creatures hold up the whole food web. Follow for more what if stories.
